intended_use: Civil airborne drone observation and tracking

blocking_findings.finding: The assembly BOM contains 14 fitted positions with SELECTION_REQUIRED and no MPN.
The assembly BOM contains 82 fitted positions marked SPEC_ONLY; exact orderable MPNs are not locked.
All 304 BOM rows have no recorded price; 47 rows have no manufacturer and 25 rows have no MPN, including PCB-only items.

BOM coordinates do not match the native Pick and Place export for C91, J1, J6 and J8. The native Pick and Place file is the geometry authority, but the conflicting BOM fields must be corrected or removed.
There are 187 via-in-pad locations: 146 copper-filled planarized microvias and 41 filled planarized copper-capped through vias. Factory process acceptance is not recorded.
The eight-layer mixed RO3003 and high-Tg FR-4 stack, controlled RF geometry and drilling spans have not received an independent factory CAM and stack feasibility review.
The current assembly drawing has sparse and faint designators and is not sufficient as the only visual assembly reference.

prototype_qualification_open: RF electromagnetic simulation and measured antenna/range performance
